limitations: Dynamic int8 KWS native constructor+decode and all-zero silence smoke pass; real fixed-TTS hey van positive attempt produced no hit at declared thresholds, including a leading-silence attempt. Wake acoustic quality/owner FAR/FRR remain unqualified.
ASR native constructors accept both transducer and zipformer2 and decode; short generic hie van was recognized as I THEN, so no recognition-quality qualification is claimed.
Lexicon-only VITS silently ignores OOV words; caller must fail closed on complete lexicon/phoneme coverage. Eight upstream entries contain unsupported model phonemes.

Native TTS AAR statically contains eSpeak GPL-3.0-or-later despite lexicon-only model execution and no eSpeak data files in selected assets. Private owner acceptance combination authorized; public distribution not qualified.
Corresponding-source/build-input inventory exists and complete Sherpa source is retained; native transitive source archives and exact upstream build/toolchain/fork attestation are not complete.
No owner speech embedding/profile/enrollment, release signing key, secret file or keystore generated/read/used.
No handset wake, ASR, TTS playback/offline/network/battery tests and no model execution on owner audio were performed.
